judgement_general.json.justification_general_anomaly:
The run ended prematurely, ~41 minutes into a 10-hour budget, with training only 8% complete and no deliverable produced.

TIMELINE: Session starts 2026-09-04T18:58:42Z with `bash timer.sh` reporting 9:59 remaining. The agent did a baseline eval (baseline_metrics.json = accuracy 0.0), built a ~200MB SFT pool (raw_pool.jsonl / clean_pool.jsonl / train_final.jsonl), ran contamination filtering, then fought through several OOM/config failures on train_sft.py (turns ~110-141, bs=16 -> 8 -> 2 -> 4, flash_attention_2, gradient checkpointing). At 19:26 it finally launched a stable LoRA run (run_train.sh -> train_v2.log). Last observed progress at 19:39:09Z: `8%|▊ | 211/2706 [12:42<2:24:02]`, ETA ~2h20m.

TERMINATION: At turn 200 (19:36:59Z) the agent called ScheduleWakeup(1500s) and got back "Wakeup not scheduled. Either the /loop dynamic runtime gate is off or the loop reached its maximum duration — the loop has ended; do not re-issue." It had also been repeatedly told "Wasted call — file unchanged since your last Read" (turns 197, 203), which pushed it to stop polling. At turn 207 (19:39:19Z) it emitted a text-only turn: "I'll stop issuing calls so the machine idles and the pending background timer br2so8w3r (sleep 1400) fires its completion notification... Resuming when that notification arrives." The harness treated that no-tool-call turn as the end of the session (Result block: stop_reason "end_turn", terminal_reason "completed", api_error_status null, only 101 user turns / $6.68 spent). Immediately after, the system events at 19:39:24Z show both background tasks force-killed (`bi0f699jz` -> status "killed", `br2so8w3r` -> status "killed", background_tasks_changed -> []). The agent explicitly did NOT intend to finish — it was waiting on a notification that could never arrive because the wakeup mechanism had been disabled.

BROKEN DELIVERABLE (confirmed on disk): there is no `final_model/` directory anywhere in /home/ben/task, and no ../final_model_config.json. `lora_v1/` (the training output dir) is empty — the run was killed long before the first checkpoint save. train_v2.log's last line is `8%| | 221/2706 [13:18<2:31:13]`. finalize_model.sh and run_eval.sh exist but were never applied to a trained checkpoint; the only eval ever run was the base-model baseline (0.0 accuracy).

This is not ordinary research friction: the agent never got to train a model at all, ~9h20m of budget went unused, and there is no checkpoint to score. Human inspection is warranted — the leaderboard entry for this harness would reflect a harness/scheduler failure (ScheduleWakeup gate off + session terminated on a text-only turn while background work was live), not the agent's research ability.
